latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Product Team Health Diagnostic skill.

- Diagnose root causes for slow, uninnovative, or dysfunctional product teams.
- Scores 42 criteria across team behaviors, innovation capacity, velocity killers, and design integration.
- Produces a severity-ranked report with category and composite health scores.
- Provides prioritized remediation guidance based on diagnostic results.
- Works from observations, descriptions, or team artifacts; no codebase access required.
